lang.toggle_help: Switch Research Lab presentation between English and 中文. Schema field names stay English.
chrome.title: MCM C Research Lab
chrome.caption: A semi-autonomous research workspace for MCM Problem C
chrome.independent_profiles_info: Independent profiles and relationship previews never auto-merge. Chart execution still requires explicit approval.
chrome.foundation_state_caption: Recorded when you initialize the project, change inputs, or persist approved EDA. run_id={run_id} · lifecycle={lifecycle}
chrome.foundation_json_caption: uploaded_files holds dataset provenance only (IDs, names, SHA-256, counts, warnings). Compact eda_report summaries omit raw rows and forbidden dense fields. File bytes are not stored here, and no trading strategy is modeled.
project.name: Project name
project.id_help: Dataset Explorer and the foundation state both use this project ID.
project.problem_help: Problem Analyst turns this into a validated ProblemSpecification. The Visual EDA Planner also uses it for chart relevance.
project.init_caption: Initialize records this project and any validated datasets already loaded below. Problem Analyst can structure the statement without starting joint modeling. Lab progress (Project → EDA → Literature → H1 → Modeling → H2 → Paper → H3) updates from the recorded run after initialize.
project.name_too_short: Project name must contain at least 3 characters.
project.inputs_updated: Project inputs updated — analysis not started. Previous approvals are stale.
dataset.intro: Upload 1 to 5 CSV or XLSX files. Each file is profiled on its own with a stable dataset ID. A single file can still prepare a chart plan. Multiple files are not joined. Saved artifacts use the project ID from the form above.
dataset.uploader_help: CSV or XLSX. Up to 5 files, 20 MB each, 50 MB combined. Files are not joined.
dataset.units: Column units (one per line: column_name = unit)
dataset.ai_planner_help: When enabled, the problem statement and compact dataset profile are sent to the configured LLM provider.
dataset.ai_warning: External model processing is enabled. The planner sends the problem statement and compact column/statistical profile, not the full raw CSV/XLSX rows.
dataset.ai_off: AI planning is off. A deterministic generic chart plan will be prepared locally.
dataset.plan_generated: Chart plan generated. Review it below before approving execution.
dataset.context_changed: The problem statement or dataset metadata changed after this plan was created. Generate a new plan before approving it.
dataset.plan_executed: Approved chart plan executed. Reports and charts have been saved.
dataset.skipped_reasons: Chart ideas not selected and why
dataset.no_charts_plan: The planner proposed no charts. Review the omission reasons below.
dataset.upload_changed_plan: The uploaded dataset changed. The previous unapproved chart plan was cleared.
dataset.upload_changed_report: The uploaded dataset changed. The previous saved report was cleared.
dataset.no_charts_generated: No charts were generated for the approved plan.
dataset.bundle_too_many: Dataset bundle accepts at most {max} files; received {n}.
dataset.record_eda: Record independent EDA into project state
dataset.init_before_eda: Initialize the project before recording EDA into project state.
dataset.sig_missing: Foundation signature missing; re-initialize the project.
dataset.eda_recorded: Independent EDA recorded into project state.
progress.caption.base: Progress follows recorded gates: Project → Problem → EDA → Literature → Research/H1 → Modeling → Validation/H2 → Paper/H3 → Export. Human H1/H2/H3 never auto-approve.
progress.caption.project: Initialize a project to record inputs and dataset provenance.
progress.caption.problem: Run Problem Analyst for a validated ProblemSpecification.
progress.caption.eda: Approve a chart plan and persist independent EDA artifacts.
progress.caption.literature: Run Literature Evidence and attach cards to the recorded run.
progress.caption.h1: Synthesize research candidates, critique them, then approve H1 to unlock modeling.
progress.caption.modeling: H1 is approved — run Modeling & Experiment when ready (does not auto-start).
progress.caption.h2: Experiment results are attached — run validation/sensitivity, then approve H2.
progress.caption.paper: H2 is approved — generate the paper package, then approve H3.
progress.caption.export: H3 is approved — E2E / export may advance; research stays human-gated.
progress.strategy_available: Strategy modeling is available via the Modeling panel after H1.
foundation.phases_caption: Initialization records the problem and dataset provenance. It does not auto-join files. Strategy modeling unlocks only after human H1.
foundation.profiles_pending: Any dataset profiles above stay on this page until you initialize the project or update its inputs. They are not in the project state yet.
foundation.mismatch: The foundation state does not match the current project inputs.
foundation.selection_rejected: The current file selection is not recorded. Fix the files and the project state will update.
foundation.relationship_ready: Relationship preview is available. Nothing is joined until you press Preview join, and a preview is not written into this state.
foundation.name_short_warn: Foundation state was not updated because the project name is too short.
foundation.id_invalid_warn: Foundation state was not updated because the project ID is invalid.
viewer.no_strengths: No explicit strength bullets — review summary and hypotheses above.
viewer.approved_caption: {gate} decision recorded — controls below are read-only.
viewer.fixture_banner: **Fixture ≠ uploads:** Dataset Explorer has **{count}** uploaded file(s), but this Modeling run uses synthetic price fixture `{fixture}` — uploaded CSVs are **not** driving the backtest.
viewer.equity_no_series: Equity artifact present but no plottable series.
viewer.no_equity: No equity_curve_summary artifact on this run.
viewer.no_numeric_deltas: No numeric deltas available for chart.
viewer.pdf_missing: PDF compile reported ok but file is missing: `{path}`. Showing outline-only view.
viewer.outline_only_failed: Outline-only view — PDF was not compiled. {note}
viewer.outline_only: Outline-only view — PDF not compiled. Enable “Attempt PDF compile” when generating if a local TeX install is available.
pa.caption: Produces a validated ProblemSpecification (Pydantic). CI uses the deterministic 2022 MCM C fixture path; optional LLM extraction still must validate.
pa.use_llm_help: Default off. When on, output still must pass ProblemSpecification validation with one repair attempt.
pa.need_statement: Paste an MCM problem statement before running the Problem Analyst.
pa.checklist_ok: 2022 C acceptance checklist: all required facts present.
pa.none_yet: No ProblemSpecification yet. Analyze the problem statement to generate one.
lit.caption: Retrieves corpus-backed evidence cards grounded to ProblemSpecification (and EDA context when present). CI uses the offline fixture corpus; live retrieval is optional and non-inventing.
lit.live_help: Default off. Phase 4 live path is a non-inventing stub that records unavailability; fixture cards remain the only concrete evidence in CI.
lit.no_spec: No ProblemSpecification available. The agent will still search the fixture corpus but will record an explicit grounding gap.
lit.ready: Evidence report ready · cards={cards} · gaps={gaps} · strategy={strategy}
lit.invented: Invented sources detected — refusing to display as verified.
lit.gaps_preview_caption: Showing all {n} gaps in this expander; {previewed} previewed above.
lit.attach: Attach evidence cards into project state
lit.attach_help: Stores a sanitized evidence_report and citations via Phase 1 persistence. Does not invent sources or mark research complete.
lit.init_before: Initialize the project before attaching evidence into project state.
lit.none_yet: No evidence report yet. Gather evidence after Problem Analyst (and optionally after EDA) to ground cards.
h1.caption: Synthesizes candidate methods from ProblemSpecification (+ EDA / Evidence when present), critiques them for contradictions / weak assumptions / evidence gaps, and requires explicit human Approve or Request-revision. H1 is never auto-approved. Modeling stays blocked until H1 is approved.
h1.use_llm_help: Default off. Phase 5 LLM path is a non-inventing stub that records unavailability; deterministic rules remain authoritative.
h1.synth_before_critique: Synthesize a research proposal before running Debate / Critic.
h1.attach_proposal_help: Stores a sanitized research_proposal via Phase 1 persistence and sets H1=pending. Does not approve H1 or unlock modeling.
h1.init_before_attach: Initialize the project before attaching a research proposal.
h1.proposal_attached: Proposal attached. H1=pending · modeling still blocked.
h1.init_before_critique: Initialize the project before attaching critique.
h1.need_proposal: Synthesize and review a proposal before H1.
h1.candidate_help: Shows plan titles — IDs remain secondary.
h1.notes_help: Required context for Approve / Request-revision decisions.
h1.approve_help: Human-only. Never auto-approved. Unlocks the modeling gate flag only.
h1.revise_help: Returns the proposal for revision; modeling remains blocked.
h1.init_before_decide: Initialize the project and attach the proposal before H1.
h1.no_candidates: Proposal has no candidates to decide on.
h1.approved_msg: H1 approved by human. modeling_allowed={allowed}. Phase 6 Modeling is not started by this action.
h1.revision_msg: H1 revision requested. Modeling remains blocked. reason={reason}
mod.caption: Runs a CI-safe deterministic trading experiment on a synthetic 2022 MCM C price fixture (not live market data). Requires human H1 approval. Does not auto-start after H1.
mod.need_proposal: Attach an H1-approved research proposal before modeling.
mod.sandbox_help: Default off. Even when enabled, Phase 6 records an unavailable stub note and keeps the deterministic fixture runner authoritative.
mod.blocked: Blocked until human H1 is approved and a proposal/candidate is available.
mod.refused_h1: Modeling refused: H1 is not approved in project state.
mod.init_before: Initialize the project and approve H1 before modeling.
mod.attach: Attach experiment results into project state
mod.attach_help: Stores sanitized experiment_logs + model_artifacts via Phase 1 persistence. Refused unless H1 is approved. Does not approve H2.
mod.init_before_attach: Initialize the project before attaching experiment results.
mod.attach_refused_h1: Attach refused: H1 is not approved in project state.
h2.caption: Runs CI-safe deterministic sensitivity on Phase 6 fixture experiment outputs (perturb costs / lookback / rebalance windows). Requires human H1 + attached experiment results. H2 never auto-approves; unlocks Paper / LaTeX only.
h2.use_llm_help: Default off. Phase 7 LLM path records an unavailable stub note; deterministic sensitivity remains authoritative.
h2.blocked: Blocked until human H1 is approved and Phase 6 experiment results are available on project state.
h2.refused: Validation refused: need H1 approved and available experiment results.
h2.init_before: Initialize the project, approve H1, and attach experiments first.
h2.attach: Attach validation report into project state
h2.attach_help: Stores sanitized validation_report via Phase 1 persistence and sets H2=pending. Does not approve H2 or unlock Paper / LaTeX.
h2.init_before_attach: Initialize the project before attaching validation.
h2.attach_refused: Attach refused: need H1 approved and experiment results.
h2.attached: Validation attached. H2=pending · paper still blocked.
h2.need_report: Run and review validation / sensitivity before H2.
h2.notes_help: Required context for Approve / Request-revision decisions.
h2.approve_help: Human-only. Never auto-approved. Unlocks the paper gate flag only.
h2.revise_help: Returns validation for revision; Paper / LaTeX remains blocked.
h2.init_before_decide: Initialize the project and attach validation before H2.
h2.revision_msg: H2 revision requested. Paper remains blocked. reason={reason}
h3.caption: Builds a CI-safe deterministic paper outline for 2022 MCM C grounded in ProblemSpecification, evidence, experiments, and validation. Optional PDF compile soft-fails without TeX. H3 never auto-approves; unlocks E2E only.
h3.use_llm_help: Default off. Phase 8 LLM path records an unavailable stub note; deterministic fixture outline remains authoritative.
h3.attempt_pdf: Attempt PDF compile (optional; soft-fails without TeX)
h3.attempt_pdf_help: Not required for CI green. Soft-fails when pdflatex is missing.
h3.run: Run deterministic paper planner + LaTeX + review
h3.blocked: Blocked until human H2 is approved on project state.
h3.refused: Paper generation refused: need H2 approved.
h3.init_before: Initialize the project and approve H2 before paper generation.
h3.attach: Attach paper package into project state
h3.attach_help: Stores sanitized paper_outline / latex_source / review_report via Phase 1 persistence and sets H3=pending. Does not approve H3 or unlock E2E.
h3.init_before_attach: Initialize the project before attaching the paper package.
h3.attached: Paper package attached. H3=pending · e2e still blocked.
h3.need_package: Run and review the paper package before H3.
h3.notes_help: Required context for Approve / Request-revision decisions.
h3.approve_help: Human-only. Never auto-approved. Unlocks the E2E gate flag only.
h3.revise_help: Returns paper for revision; Phase 9 E2E remains blocked.
h3.init_before_decide: Initialize the project and attach the paper package before H3.
h3.revision_msg: H3 revision requested. E2E remains blocked. reason={reason}
pers.caption: Save / reopen / continue recorded runs. File bytes are not stored — re-upload matching datasets before EDA.
pers.no_active: No saved active run for this project ID.
pers.nothing_continue: Nothing to continue for this project ID.
pers.reopened: Reopened provenance for run {run_id}. Re-upload matching files before EDA.
pers.stale_history: Loaded a stale historical run. Approvals from that version must not be reused.
pers.data_resume: **Data resume:** `{v}` (provenance only — not a full EDA resume)
common.sig_missing: Foundation signature missing; re-initialize the project.
